summary: A six-channel groovebox firmware written from scratch, with modeled drums, a sample slicer and four switchable synth machines modeled on classic instruments, all rendered live at 44.1 kHz. Beta, tested on one unit.
features: BR-8 TR-style drums: 16 instruments, each with its own length
BP-1 Slicer cuts a take into 16 pads with a step grid
Synth machines: BB-303, B-MINI, BX-7 6-op FM, BITTAL wavetable, BUNO-6
HOME mixer: 9 patterns, per-channel filter, delay, reverb, 4 mute scenes
Per-track length (1-64 steps) and speed; MIDI in, clock in, sync out
Updates may erase saved patterns until v1; browser emulator available
